HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJEEV NARULA  ORDER % 02.12.2025 CRL.M.A. 33909/2025 (Exemption from filing certified copies)
1. Exemptions are granted, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The Petitioner shall file legible and clearer copies of exempted documents, compliant with practice rules, before the next date of hearing.
3. Accordingly, the applications stand disposed of.

4. The present petition under Section 528 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraskha Sanhita, 2023 (formerly Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) seeks setting aside of order dated 06th September, 2025 passed by the Additional Sessions Judge, East District, Karkardooma Courts in CRL.REV 05/2025.
